metadata.name: ckodex-skill-tools
metadata.description: Scaffold new CKODEX v1.1 skills from a blank slate, and migrate existing Agent Skills v1 skills to v1.1 in place. Use whenever the user asks to create, start, bootstrap a skill, or upgrade/migrate a v1 skill to v1.1.
metadata.synopsis: When the user asks to create a new skill, start a skill, bootstrap a skill, or migrate an existing v1 skill to v1.1: this skill provides two stdlib-only Python CLIs. scaffold.py produces a complete fresh skill tree (SKILL.md, skill.json with synopsis+ontology+runtime stubs, references/, scripts/validate.sh, MANIFEST.json) that passes validate.sh 0F/0W on first run. migrate.py upgrades an existing tree in place: parses SKILL.md frontmatter, composes a bounded synopsis from the body, bumps apiVersion to v1.1, adds ontology+runtime stubs marked with MIGRATION: comments, preserves all author-authored fields. Both tools default to dry-run and require --apply to write. Both refuse on conflict unless --force. NOT a substitute for hand-authoring complex ontology blocks; the stubs are starting points the author finishes by hand.

agentSkillsFrontmatter.compatibility: Python 3.10+, stdlib only. Filesystem write access required for --apply mode.
